description: Display and evidence-search grouping by official corridor color. A color family groups related corridors for source discovery only; it does not merge CTM systems, station identifiers, operating status, or service topology.

families.topologyNote: Lines 2A and 2B are distinct corridors with distinct CTM systems and station sets. MMRDA identifies interchange/proximity at D.N. Nagar; yellow color does not imply a shared station ID or through-service.

Line 9 is documented as the northern extension of Line 7. Line 7A is the airport branch. Keep the three corridor IDs, operational states, and station entities separate even though the passenger-facing family color is Red.
Line 6 is an independent corridor from Swami Samarth Nagar to Vikhroli (EEH). Its Pink family label is for source discovery and styling only.

Line 4, Line 4A, Line 10, and Line 11 remain distinct corridor IDs and station sequences within the Green color family. In particular, separate the Line 4A extension from Line 4 instead of storing their combined station total on one line.
Line 5 and Line 12 are separate Orange corridors, with a planned interchange at Kalyan; do not combine their station IDs or sequences.
